name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Provides income support of Rs 6,000 per year to small and marginal farmer families across India to supplement their financial needs for procuring inputs related to agriculture and allied activities.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year paid in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 directly to the bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: A crop insurance scheme that provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to unforeseen events like natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefits: Insurance coverage and financial support for crop loss. Premium as low as 1.5% for Rabi crops and 2% for Kharif crops.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) – Central Schemes
description: An umbrella portal for various central government scholarships for students from minority communities, SC, ST, OBC, and EWS backgrounds to support their education.
benefits: Annual scholarship ranging from Rs 1,000 to Rs 25,000 depending on the scheme and level of study.
department: Ministry of Education / Ministry of Minority Affairs

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: A maternity benefit programme that provides cash incentives to pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first living child to improve health and nutrition.
benefits: Cash benefit of Rs 5,000 paid in two instalments directly to the bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Provides financial assistance to rural households to construct pucca houses with basic amenities. Priority given to SC/ST households, minorities, and persons with disabilities.
benefits: Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly or difficult areas for house construction.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Financial inclusion scheme ensuring access to financial services like banking, savings, credit, insurance, and pension to those excluded from the formal financial system.
benefits: Zero-balance bank account, RuPay debit card, Rs 1 lakh accident insurance, Rs 30,000 life insurance cover.

name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing coverage up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per year per family for listed medical procedures at empanelled hospitals.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
description: A scheme to address the declining child sex ratio and promote welfare and education of the girl child across India.
benefits: Awareness campaigns, conditional cash transfers in some states, scholarships, and free education support for girls.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment at the statutory minimum wage rate.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides micro-finance loans up to Rs 10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises to help them grow their business.
benefits: Collateral-free loans: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,001–5 lakh), Tarun (Rs 5–10 lakh).

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Maharashtra state scheme providing monthly financial assistance to women from economically weaker sections to promote their financial independence.
benefits: Rs 1,500 per month directly credited to the woman's bank account.
department: Government of Maharashtra – Women & Child Development

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
benefits: Loan between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

name: PM SVANidhi – PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Provides affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods affected due to COVID-19.
benefits: Collateral-free loans of Rs 10,000 initially, extendable to Rs 20,000 and Rs 50,000 on timely repayment.
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Rajasthan Palanhar Yojana
description: Rajasthan state scheme providing financial assistance for the upbringing and education of orphaned or destitute children within their extended family.
benefits: Rs 500/month for children up to 5 years; Rs 1,000/month for children aged 6–18 years. Additional Rs 2,000/year for clothing and stationery.
department: Government of Rajasthan – Social Justice & Empowerment

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Provides free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households to protect their health and reduce household pollution.
benefits: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove (chulha) subsidised.
